# MyTranscript

> MyTranscript (https://www.mytranscript.pro) is a fast, free, and privacy-friendly AI platform for YouTube transcription and intelligent video summarization. Paste any YouTube video or Shorts URL to instantly extract clean timestamped subtitles, generate key takeaways, chapter breakdowns, and interact directly with video content without registration or extensions.

## Core Features & Tools

- [Homepage](https://www.mytranscript.pro/): Paste any YouTube URL to extract transcripts and generate AI summaries instantly.
- [Web App](https://www.mytranscript.pro/app/): Access the clean, full-screen transcript extraction and analysis workspace.

## Articles & Guides

- [Articles & Knowledge Base](https://www.mytranscript.pro/articles/): Practical guides on YouTube transcription, AI summarization benchmarks, and subtitle extraction.

## Technical Architecture & Privacy

- **Framework**: Next.js 14 App Router, React 18, and Tailwind CSS.
- **AI Engine**: Integrated with Google Gemini 2.5 Flash and OpenRouter LLM gateways for rapid, high-context comprehension.
- **Privacy First**: Zero persistent user tracking, no sign-up or cookies required.
